cohort: Pregnant women in Alberta, Canada,  between 2006 and 2009 inclusive; 116 with IBD and 381 without IBD (matched by age at conception)
finding: Women with IBD were independently more likely to experience gestational diabetes, preterm birth, and undergo cesarean section compared to a healthy age-matched population.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common in women with IBD compared to the control group.
